publisher: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

Agriculture.method_summary: Livestock, soils and machinery emissions are distributed using 2024 agricultural census and survey data acquired at holding level, combined with UKCEH spatial modelling.
Agriculture.caution: CH4 and N2O estimates depend strongly on environmental conditions and model assumptions; do not interpret as parcel measurements.

Commercial.method_summary: Electricity and gas use rely on DESNZ meter-based geographical allocation; other fuels use employment and fuel-intensity modelling.
Commercial.caution: Other-fuel spatial distributions are materially less certain than metered electricity and gas.

Domestic.method_summary: Electricity and gas use are principally meter-based; other fuels use household energy-demand and population models.
Domestic.caution: Domestic/non-domestic classification and estimated meter readings introduce additional uncertainty.

Industry.method_summary: Metered energy, reported regulatory point sources and employment-based area modelling are combined.
Industry.caution: ETS point-source records are generally stronger geographically than area-modelled other fuels.

LULUCF.method_summary: UKCEH and Forest Research estimate land-use emissions and removals, including sources and sinks of CO2 plus CH4 and N2O.
LULUCF.caution: LULUCF uncertainty is sufficiently high that it is excluded from the standard local-authority uncertainty calculation; negative values are valid removals, not data errors.

Public Sector.method_summary: Public-sector electricity and gas follow non-domestic meter allocation; other fuels use area modelling and surrogate activity data.
Public Sector.caution: Small-source coal and liquid-fuel distributions have limited direct geographical evidence.

Transport.method_summary: Vehicle flows, fleet composition, speed-related fuel factors and mapped road networks are combined; rail and other transport use separate spatial proxies.
Transport.caution: Minor-road and transport-other estimates are less geographically precise than major-road estimates.

Waste.method_summary: Landfill methane is allocated using devolved-government waste-origin data and national inventory totals; other waste sources use population and facility data.
Waste.caution: Waste is CH4-dominated and national emission uncertainty is high; estimates can differ from bottom-up carbon-factor calculations.
